source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES uses an AND substring match but still assumes collection shape, can select similarly named entries, disables TLS and omits topology, lifecycle and no-update proof.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires exact UBB FPGA mapping, complete active/staged/updateability evidence and strict read-only handling.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 967/2291 accepts the substring command with a generic gate.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The UBB assembly record and SMC_FPGA are distinct identities; neither can satisfy this exact UBB FPGA firmware checkpoint.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 retains WebUI evidence; ED-34 permits approved collectors; ED-35 prevents substring/version-only coverage; ED-36 treats mapping/reference as readiness; ED-44 preserves exact firmware target.

original_test_intent: Verify the exact UBB FPGA firmware inventory shown by BMC is readable and correct.
original_method: Enumerate all firmware inventory, map the target FPGA to the intended UBB through vendor topology and stable ID, collect complete protected read-only lifecycle fields, and compare with WebUI and the approved firmware matrix without firmware action.
manual_activity: The owner binds the UBB FPGA physical instance to its immutable firmware record and approves lifecycle expectations. The agent may collect inventory only; engineer owns discrepancies and verdict.
safety_requirements: Do not upload, update, rollback, reset or reboot.
Do not use UBB+FPGA name substrings as sole identity.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Keep active and staged images distinct.
Stop on missing/duplicate targets or unknown lifecycle state without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate the complete protected FirmwareInventory collection.
Resolve the UBB FPGA via stable vendor ID and physical relation.
Collect full redacted version, status, health, active/staged, updateability and timestamp evidence.
Correlate with WebUI and Project matrix.
Return evidence only; invoke no UpdateService action.
engineer_actions: Approve lifecycle semantics and expected versions.
Review mismatch and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A candidate finder only: substring matching, assumed array shape and untrusted TLS cannot establish exact component or lifecycle correctness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Follow the actual collection links/pages and use a topology-backed immutable ID, then compare complete read-only lifecycle data.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: UBB_FPGA, WebUI inspection, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use exact-target complete firmware-inventory parity under a no-update/no-reset boundary.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, UpdateService schema and parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor UBB FPGA topology/lifecycle specification and Project firmware matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical-to-logical target binding, complete lifecycle fields and explicit no-update controls while retaining WebUI validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A name match or version alone cannot prove physical target, active image, staged state, health or updateability.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Exact component map and approved lifecycle/version baseline.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A similarly named FPGA can produce a false pass; accidental firmware action could affect platform management/connectivity.

project_override_considerations: Alternate inventory tools require the same exact UBB FPGA binding and lifecycle coverage, engineer approval and disclosure of any missing WebUI/Redfish checkpoint; they do not authorize update.
expected_evidence: UBB FPGA physical/topology and stable-ID map
Complete raw redacted paginated firmware record

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master clearly targets UBB_FPGA inventory; the weak substring implementation does not create a second target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only firmware inventory purpose is clear; exact mapping and expected lifecycle values are Project readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Upgrades a substring candidate search to exact physical/firmware identity and lifecycle reconciliation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and no-update controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds identity, pagination and lifecycle gates absent from direct-run review.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Prevents UBB chassis or SMC FPGA evidence from substituting for UBB FPGA.

review_improvement: Prevents wrong-FPGA and staged-versus-active false passes while preserving a strictly read-only scope.
independent_technical_reasoning: Multiple firmware components may contain both UBB and FPGA text. Only a vendor-stable ID plus physical topology can identify the intended device, and lifecycle correctness requires knowing which image is active versus staged; reading inventory cannot be expanded into update permission.
